The Sixers sit atop the Eastern Conference standings after a red-hot 13-3 start. They won't have Jaylen Brown (hamstring) in this one, while Tyrese Maxey (foot) is listed as questionable. A win is a tough ask for the 1-15 Bucks, who sit in last in the conference, though Milwaukee has stayed within large spreads in four of its past five.
